$comment: The Waivers plugin's page, natively (AGL-4042): the site's waivers (status, version, how long a signature lasts, the share link), writing one with its version history, publish, unpublish and retire, and the signatures (searched by a name, an email or a day, narrowed to one waiver, exported as a spreadsheet, one opened with its audit trail, voided, or downloaded as the signed PDF), a waiver signed at the window on staff's own device (the rider's details, minors, the boxes, the e-sign consent, a drawn or typed signature, then the signed copy's code and the next signer), and a waiver signed on paper recorded with a photo of the page. Calls the console's own waivers routes as the console does. Grammar: docs/mobile/native-architecture.md section 13.
